content:
name: Build Extension

on:
  push:
    branches: [ "main", "master" ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "main", "master" ]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: set up JDK 17
      uses: actions/setup-java@v4
      with:
        java-version: '17'
        distribution: 'temurin'

    - name: Setup Gradle
      uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v3

    - name: Build APK
      run: gradle assembleDebug

    - name: Upload APK
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: webdav-anime-extension
        path: build/outputs/apk/debug/*.apk

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<manifest xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android">

    <application
        android:hasCode="true"
        android:label="Aniyomi: WebDAV Anime"
        android:icon="@drawable/ic_launcher">
        <meta-data
            android:name="tachiyomi.animeextension"
            android:value="1.0" />
        <meta-data
            android:name="tachiyomi.extension.class"
            android:value="eu.kanade.tachiyomi.animeextension.all.webdav.WebDAV" />
    </application>

</manifest>
